events.name: SG Cabinet - "Serve the Swamp: Volunteer Fair
events.description:
The Community & Service Volunteer Fair will be an event hosted by the Community & Service Cabinet designed to connect University of Florida students with meaningful volunteer and service opportunities throughout Gainesville and the surrounding community. The event will bring local nonprofit organizations, community partners, service-focused organizations, and UF student organizations involved in community service together on campus, giving students an accessible way to learn about different causes and discover opportunities that align with their interests.

Throughout the event, participating organizations will have tables where representatives can speak directly about their mission, the populations or causes they serve, and the different ways UF students can become involved. Students will have the opportunity to explore a variety of service areas, ask questions, learn about one-time and recurring volunteer opportunities, and receive information about how to begin volunteering with organizations that interest them. By bringing these organizations directly to campus, the event aims to reduce some of the barriers that may prevent students from becoming involved in community service, particularly not knowing what opportunities are available or how to get started.

The overall goal of the Community & Service Volunteer Fair is to make community involvement more visible, accessible, and approachable for UF students while strengthening the relationship between the University of Florida and the greater Gainesville community. Students should leave the event with a better understanding of the service opportunities available to them, and, ideally with at least one organization or cause they are interested in becoming involved with. The event will support the cabinet’s broader mission of encouraging students to engage with and give back to the community beyond UF’s campus.

events.description:
Women’s Ultimate is passionate about creating an inclusive student organization that promotes and values diversity. Our commitment to inclusion across race, gender, ethnicity, religion, or any other aspects that make our members unique is what allows our club to strengthen and grow. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination and strive to incorporate diversity, equity, and inclusion practices at the center of organization.

The UF Women's Ultimate Frisbee Club Team was founded in 2001, originally as "FUEL" (Florida Ultimate Elite Ladies).

The club includes both FUEL and our B-Team, DIESEL. Any UF student is welcome to come out and play and we guarantee you'll have a great time. There is a spot for everyone! The majority of people who come out have never played before.

Both teams compete in 4-6 tournaments a year against other schools, mostly in the southeast. However, FUEL has traveled as far as California, Texas, and Colorado in the last few years for competition.

We are funded by the University, which covers the majority of our costs.

FUEL qualified for Nationals in 2006, 2007, 2011, 2012, 2017 and 2018. In their seventh year, DIESEL was the only B-team to have qualified for and played in Regionals.

Come join us for practice and see what it's all about!

There will also be a “jackpot” slot of the wheel with top tech prizes, with a choice between selecting a reliable portable charger or a keychain tracker (similar to AirTag). The UF Women's Ultimate Frisbee Club Team was founded 19 years ago, originally as "FUEL" (Florida Ultimate Elite Ladies).

The club includes both FUEL and our B-Team, DIESEL. Any UF student is welcome to come out and play and we guarantee you'll have a great time. There is a spot for everyone! The majority of people who come out have never played before.

We will be tabling every week on Tuesday and Thursday from 12:00 PM to 3:00 PM. I made reservations depending on availability, so there are days that we will be tabling in Turlington Plaza or Newell Hall.
 
Here are all the reservations.
  • September 15: Newell, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • September 17: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • September 22: Newell + Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • September 24: Newell + Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • September 29: Newell + Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 1: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 6: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 8: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 13: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 15: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 20: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 22: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
  • October 27: Turlington, 12 PM to 3 PM
